notes.title: A wild spaceship has appeared
notes.content:
We have recently completed 2 Years of development on this game.
In light of this milestone, we have decided to introduce a new quirky spaceship named Froggy-2
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43383804/35a6faf920dc0a5cd35c52f1cdd6f3b1ebfbd354.gif

Keen eyes will notice few things like,

 Weak Forward Thrusters
 Zero Linear Stabilization

Thus giving pure newtonian flight model unlike Elite Dangerous.
To compensate lesser fun due to this approach, we have given powerful rear thrusters so you can brake faster, when needed to shake sharper turns.
Another thing you will notice that the shield resistance is at 0 Dings. Thus not being slowed down by collisions with Rocky obstacles, They will feel as smooth as the Icy Obstacles.

We will leave this for the pros to exploit and make some awesome world records.

Other milestones reached after completion of 2 Years:

 We have now over 10K registered players* in-game {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43383804/8a2a66d44b7337ef7d69338b2c142115de09cfc0.png
 The game has been played over 148 countries* {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43383804/09e9163b00670a232e9616306bce62d76326d0ac.png
 We have over 30K race time submissions, across various spaceship and track combinations {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43383804/6c4effab25da50bd05d0303415fbec1d2ae7aeb6.png

*includes data from all platforms where the game is available.

notes.title: [V148] Medals are now available for getting some good times.
notes.content:
We have listened to your feedback that not everyone wants to beat the top time. You want a medal for your good enough efforts.
Now its possible to win upto 4 medals per track and ship combo.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43383804/56db962e5bd2782c694f2446087310fff94f86bf.png

 Terra Medal, Be in top 50% of the players who have played this combo
 Luna Medal, Be in top 75% of the players who have played this combo
 Sol Medal, Be in top 90% of the players who have played this combo
 Sirius Medal, Be in top 99% of the players who have played this combo


Medals are only available on tracks played by atleast 10 players. (this number might change in the future).

notes.title: New Update (v144/v145): Steam Achievements and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Added Steam Achievements
